name: Coit Street Lawn and Garden Maintenance
description: Coit Street is a downtown Florence yard we stay on all year. We mow and edge, keep the beds mulched, prune, and change the color with the season in the gardens, the baskets on the porch, and the pots by the steps. The point is a yard that looks tended every week, not only after a cleanup.
metaDescription: Year-round lawn and garden care on Coit Street in downtown Florence, with mowing, mulched beds, pruning, and seasonal color.
story: This one is maintenance, not a new install. On Coit Street we mow, edge, and blow off the walks and patio. The beds stay mulched and weeded, and we prune the shrubs and cut things back when the season turns. Color goes in the front beds, in baskets on the porch, and in the pots by the steps. It gets looked after all year, not just after a big cleanup.
